title: Identity provider compromise
narrative: At 08:40 UTC an attacker forges tokens through the identity provider and destroys the storefront and Orders API deployments. The identity provider must be rebuilt from a trusted recovery point before anything that relies on it can return to service.

injections.description: Identity provider signing keys abused; storefront and Orders API deployments destroyed.

recommended_actions: Rebuild the identity provider first and rotate its signing keys
Then restore the Orders API, then the storefront
